name: Envelope Budget
note: Envelope budgeting where every figure derives from integer-cent state: drag an Available pill onto another envelope (or press M) and a coin flies along a WAAPI arc while the money moves; bars ease through a spring linear() curve and a scroll-driven header shadow runs in the list's own scroller. Set --apb-envelope-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Bill Pay Calendar
note: Bill pay driven by a projected checking balance: drag a bill along the day lane (or use the arrow keys) and the step line re-projects live, its CSS d property springing between paths while a clip-path paints every day below your buffer. name: Transfer & Receipt
note: A send-money flow whose confirm is a press-and-hold: a registered @property number drives both the conic ring and the fill, transitions back down when you let go, and Space works the same as the pointer. The receipt prints in with clip-path behind a zig-zag mask, balances tween and the activity list FLIPs the new row in. Set --apb-transfer-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Invoice Builder
note: An invoice editor beside a live A4 sheet typeset in container-query units, so the preview scales like a PDF thumbnail and snaps to 100% on demand. VAT is totalled per rate after discount in integer pence so the sheet always reconciles; lines reorder by drag, Alt+arrow or a grab-mode grip with FLIP, and a recorded payment springs a PAID stamp on. Set --apb-invoice-h to 100dvh in an app.
html: Saltmarsh JoineryInvoices

name: Receipt Capture
note: Snap-to-report expenses: a scan beam sweeps a CSS-drawn thermal receipt, then field boxes positioned from offset geometry inside the tilted paper (so they rotate with it) spring in with a stagger, each linked both ways to its form field and flagged when confidence is low. Policy checks (receipt over $25, meals over $75 a day) gate submission and a matching scan offers to attach itself. Set --apb-receipts-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Savings Waterfall
note: Savings goals as a priority waterfall: the monthly amount pours down the list, each card fills like a basin to its share (registered --apb-goals-fill and --apb-goals-p properties transition the wave and the ring), and a dashed stream carries what is left to the next goal. A month-by-month simulation drives every status and a DPR-aware canvas that plots each goal as a percent of its own target. Set --apb-goals-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Net Worth Timeline
note: A net-worth tracker where one table of monthly balances drives everything: drag or arrow through the stacked asset/liability canvas (a role=slider, DPR-aware, eased with an exponential tween) and the headline, balance sheet, sparklines and deltas rewind to that month. Leaving out the home or any account re-stacks the chart, and $50k milestones are found from the data, not hard-coded. Set --apb-networth-h to 100dvh in an app.
